hero.heading: Crafted by Nature,
hero.description: We don't just process materials. We document the transformation of raw coconut husk into the world's most sustainable architectural fiber.

mission.title: The Mission
mission.description: To bridge the gap between industrial necessity and ecological integrity. We repurpose agricultural waste into high-performance materials that give back to the soil from which they came.

vision.title: The Vision
vision.description: A world where every structure is supported by the living loom of nature. We strive to be the global standard for carbon-negative architectural substrates by 2030.

founder.label: The Hands Behind the Fiber
founder.heading: A Legacy Rooted in the Soil.
founder.description: Founder Mr. A. Siva Prakash established Suriya Coirs in 2007 in Pollachi, Tamil Nadu, the heartland of fine coir production. Guided by a strong vision of excellence, he built the company to transform nature's most sustainable fiber into refined, high-quality products for the global marketplace.
founder.quote: We carry forward a legacy of delivering India's natural excellence to the world with distinction and integrity.

milestones.heading: Our Growth Rings
milestones.description: Like the palms we harvest from, our journey is marked by steady, organic growth rooted in trust, transparency, and uncompromising quality.

items.title: The Inception (2007)
items.description: Established by Mr. A. Siva Prakash in Kallipatti, Pollachi. Built on a vision of excellence and authenticity, we evolved from a dedicated manufacturing unit into a distinguished export enterprise serving discerning clients across international markets.

items.title: Global Demand
items.description: Specializing in the export of premium coir fibre, coco pith, husk chips, grow bags, and coir ropes. Each offering is meticulously crafted to meet international standards while retaining the natural integrity of coir for agricultural and horticultural applications.

items.title: Sustainable Legacy
items.description: Under visionary leadership, we uphold a deep commitment to sustainability and responsible sourcing. We deliver environmentally friendly solutions, carrying forward a legacy of delivering India's natural excellence to the world with distinction.
